tools.name: create_event
tools.description: Create an entry on the user's own calendar. No other people are invited. Do not use this for meetings that invite other people, reserving a meeting room or to-do list tasks.

tools.name: schedule_event
tools.description: Set up a meeting with other people and email them invitations. Do not use this for the user's own calendar entries, reserving a meeting room or to-do list tasks.

tools.name: book_event
tools.description: Reserve a meeting room for a time slot. Does not add anything to a calendar. Do not use this for the user's own calendar entries, meetings that invite other people or to-do list tasks.

tools.name: add_event
tools.description: Add a task with a due date to the user's to-do list. Does not create calendar entries. Do not use this for the user's own calendar entries, meetings that invite other people or reserving a meeting room.
